findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection with shell=True
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True can lead to command injection if user input is involved
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-shell
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node shellArg
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  ) and
  (
    shellArg = call.getArgByName("shell") or
    shellArg = call.getArg(4)  // shell is often 4th positional arg in some calls
  ) and
  shellArg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
select call, "Subprocess call with shell=True may be vulnerable to command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Detecting subprocess calls with shell=True which are more vulnerable to command injection

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal vulnerability
 * @description Using user-controlled data in file paths without validation can lead to path traversal
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember("join").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall()
  ) and
  // Only flag if there's string concatenation or join with ".."
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg | 
    arg = call.getArg(_) and
    arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText().matches("%..%")
  )
select call, "Potential path traversal vulnerability with '..' in path."
findings.hypothesis: Check for path traversal vulnerabilities where paths containing '..' are used in file operations

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials
 * @description Hardcoded passwords, tokens, or API keys in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Assign assign, StrConst str
where
  (
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches("%password%") or
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches("%passwd%") or
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches("%api_key%") or
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches("%apikey%") or
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches("%secret%") or
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches("%token%")
  ) and
  assign.getValue() = str and
  not str.getText() = "" and
  not str.getText().matches("%{%")
select assign, "Potential hardcoded credential: " + assign.getATarget().(Name).getId()
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded passwords, API keys, tokens, or secrets in the codebase
